descriptions.zh-Hans: 在台北吃过牛肉面后写的小菜单，第一行留给了先出发的汤匙。
descriptions.en: My menu after beef noodle soup in Taipei. The spoon gets the opening line.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 记着台北小笼包的一张菜单，名字旁的小点是等午饭稍凉的空当。
descriptions.en: A Taipei xiaolongbao menu, with a dot for the pause while lunch cooled.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 看台北101时给自己的提醒，写完又忍不住抬了一次头。
descriptions.en: A personal reminder from looking up at Taipei 101. I immediately looked up again.

names.en: A Dot for the Lunch Pause

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在台北吃小笼包时留下的小纸条，一个点记住了一段安静的等待。
descriptions.en: A slip from xiaolongbao in Taipei. One dot keeps a quiet wait for lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在北投温泉博物馆看建筑后做的颜色笔记，最浅的一格还留着光的位置。
descriptions.en: My colour notes after seeing the Beitou Hot Spring Museum. The palest square leaves room for light.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在台北问路时和旅伴写下的两个打算，“先坐一会儿”排在最上面。
descriptions.en: Two plans written with a traveler in Taipei. A short rest comes first.
